title: General.
officialText:
The design of masonry structures using strength design shall comply with Section 2106 and the requirements of
Chapters 1 and 3 of TMS 402/ ACI 530/ASCE 5 , except as modified by Sections 2108.2 through 2108.3 of this code.
Exception: AAC masonry shall comply with the requirements of Chapter 1 and Appendix A of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE
5.
